This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989.

Appellant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.113/2024 registered at Police Station Damua, District - Chhindwara for the offences punishable under Sections 376-D and 392 of IPC and Sections 3 (2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Appellant is in jail since 07.05.2024.
Prosecution story, in brief, is that at the alleged date, time and place, appellant established physical relations with prosecutrix, aged about 24 years without her consent and against her will.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that it is a case of consent.
Prosecutrix is major, aged about 24 years.
It is the prosecutrix, who had called the present appellant Vishal Yadav.
It is also urged that prosecutrix has NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:50872 2 CRA-9908-2024 no objection, if the appellant is granted bail.
Appellant has been falsely implicated in the case.
He further submits that the trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the appellant be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
Learned counsel for the Objector has no objection, if the appellant is released on bail.
Having regard to nature of evidence available on record, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Consequently, this appeal stands allowed.

It is directed that appellant- Vishal Yadav be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
